description: Distretto Po - Sismica - Microzonazione sismica is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by vcloud.ilger.com. The activity of seismic microzonation is aimed at the geo-referenced representation of the results obtained in the project, seismic verifications of the Argini on the right bank of the river Po in the stretch between Ro (FE) and Boretto (RE)-. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "District Po — Seismic — Microzonation seismic" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
